qs.vlm: ♦ Oct. Aug. c. 67. Aristophanes in *Equites*, 1359. Ἄραν μετεωρον εἰς το βαραθρον ἐμβαλῶ, Ἐκ του λαρυγγος ἐκκρεμασας ὑπερβολον. Diodorus Siculus, book xvi., says, "Philip hanged Onomarchus," τους δε ἀλλους ὡς ἱεροσυλους κατεποντισε. Halhed, in his Code of Gentoo Laws, inserts the following, "If a woman cause any person to take poison, set fire to any person's house, or murder a man, then the magistrate, having bound a stone to her neck, shall drown her." "A millstone;" in Luke, μυλος ὀνικος, a large millstone, such a millstone as could not be turned with the hand, but required an ass, or other working animal, to move it. In Mark ix. 42, λιθος μυλικος.
